reviews.text: Got me on quickly to see my cat same day, very helpful and informative, and the staff are clearly animal lovers.
Excellent service 👍 …

The staff is always so courteous, polite and helpful. Every time I bring my fur babies in they treat them as family. Dr. K. is so on point she has a caring bedside manner when it comes to caring for her patient's needs. Thank you for all that you do 🥰

I had a great experience bringing my puppy to this vet clinic! Dr kocher was amazing, but also the vet tech, Jennifer, was especially awesome and made sure my puppy and I felt comfortable throughout the visit. You can really tell that they care about the animals they work with. I’m so thankful for how well Dr Kocher and Jennifer treated my puppy. I definitely recommend this clinic to anyone looking for great care for their pets!
Always a pleasant experience to come here with a difficult dog.  They keep her calm and perform the exam without issues.
Ms. Mendoza, thank you for your 5 star review.  Thank you for trusting your babies with our staff.

Tried Love Freeway Animal Clinic for the first time this week after feeling increasingly that our other vet in the neighborhood was nickel and dime-ing us. Brought one of our pups in who wasn't eating and was struggling to go to the bathroom. We were concerned about an obstruction, but they tested her stool in clinic and confirmed a bacterial infection instead.

They were able to see us same day, got us in and out within an hour, and we left with 3 meds, 6 cans of food, and a pup who immediately started feeling better for only $225.

Dr. Kocher and tech Jennifer were also great with our super skittish rescue pup. Will definitely be back with our other pets as needed! Thank you Love Freeway team!!
Excellent service and great treatment of the animals, congratulations!
Dr. Kocher and the staff are wonderful.
I truly love this place and the staff here. They are so wonderful and kind. It's why I always bring my babies here.
Mr. Younger, thank you for the 5 star review.  The staff appreciates people taking their time to show their hard work been acknowledged.
You guys are amazing !!

Thank you for the 5 star review.  We would be grateful if in the future you can specify which staff or the specific effort which was exceptional so I can recognize my staffs hard work they perform daily.  Again, thank you.

Ms. Treviso,
Thank you  for the 5 star review of our clinic.
Today was my first time taking Katie here and service was amazing !!! They were very gentle with Katie !

I’m very disappointed with my experience at Love Freeway Pet Hospital and Grooming.

The first time my pet was shaved extremely short, I was told it was due to matting. I gave them the benefit of the doubt. However, the second time, I made sure to thoroughly brush my pet beforehand. When I picked him up, he was shaved down again and I was told his fur was matted.

I requested to see proof and asked for video of the alleged matting. The video shown did not clearly show any severe matting that would justify shaving him down the way they did. Instead of addressing my concerns professionally, I was told they would no longer groom my pet simply because I questioned the service.

There was no apology, no attempt to resolve the issue, and no accountability. My pet was shaved down excessively and left looking uneven and uncomfortable. As a paying customer, I expected transparency and professionalism, especially when it comes to my pet’s care.

If you want quality grooming for a long-haired pet, I would not recommend this place based on my experience.
Kindness and expertise
Britney did an awesome job she was very helpful was very caring & dedicated to make sure my dog had everything she needed
Very efficient, experienced, and compassionate staff.

Wonderful and very friendly and helpful
